topics.title: Watching YouTube Box Openings???
topics.excerpt:
This has always surprised me. Millions of people watching others open Pokemon boxes. 
Yes, I know I’m in the great minority but I just don’t get it. I have no interest in viewing one of these videos. In fact, it would be…
